Ability.Name: -- Motor MRC --
Ability.Lua: if not MRC then MRC={} MRC.Book={} function MRC.Refresh() MRC.Book={} if not GetSpellName then return end for i=1,300 do local n=GetSpellName(i,BOOKTYPE_SPELL); if not n then break end; MRC.Book[n]=true end end function MRC.Known(n) if not MRC.Book or not next(MRC.Book) then MRC.Refresh() end; return MRC.Book[n]==true end function MRC.Cast(n,aoe) if StopRota or not MRC.Known(n) then return false end if aoe and not IsShiftKeyDown() then return false end if not aoe and IsShiftKeyDown() then return false end if UnitCastingInfo("player") or UnitChannelInfo("player") then return false end if not UnitExists("target") or UnitIsDeadOrGhost("target") or not IsUsableSpell(n) then return false end if not UnitCanAttack('player','target') then return false end local s,d=GetSpellCooldown(n) if s and d and d>1.6 and s+d>GetTime() then return false end local range=IsSpellInRange(n,"target"); if range==0 then return false end CastSpellByName(n); return true end end return false

Ability.Name: -- Control MRC --
Ability.Lua: if IsLeftControlKeyDown() and not MRC.ctrl then MRC.ctrl=true; StopRota=not StopRota; PQR_WriteToChat(StopRota and "MRC pausado" or "MRC activo") elseif not IsLeftControlKeyDown() then MRC.ctrl=false end; return false

Ability.Name: -- Descarga de las Sombras --
Ability.Lua: return MRC.Cast("Descarga de las Sombras", false)
